description: This file defines a React context and provider for managing theme settings in a web application. It includes theme mode toggle functionality, applies theme styles to the DOM, and exports navigation items with role-based access control.

methods.name: ThemeProvider
methods.description: Provides theme settings via React context, persists settings to localStorage, and applies CSS variables based on current theme.

methods.name: useThemeSettings
methods.description: Custom React hook for accessing theme context (settings and toggle function).
